title: AI Ecosystem Link (relationship)
description: Directed company-to-company relationships. This is the layer Hudson Labs' Sankey structurally cannot render, and the reason this project exists.

source.description: Node id. Direction is source -> target, read as 'source provides/commits to target'. D3 mutates this into an object reference at runtime — never persist a settled graph.

value_usd_m.description: Disclosed deal value in USD millions. Null when undisclosed — link renders dashed.

pct_of_source_revenue.description: What share of SOURCE's revenue this relationship represents. Customer concentration risk. e.g. Microsoft was ~60%+ of CoreWeave revenue.

pct_of_target_cogs.description: What share of TARGET's cost base this represents. Supplier dependency.

exposure_note.description: Read-across: what happens to each side if this relationship changes.

citation.description: Provenance for the relationship. Named `citation` because `source` is the D3 edge endpoint.
Provenance for a single figure. Required whenever a value is present.

as_of.description: Date the figure was reported, not the date scraped.

quote.description: Short supporting excerpt. Keep under 300 chars.
